description: A four channel mono mixer with level, pan and a clickless mute on each channel, feeding a stereo pair of chain outputs

params.text: Sets the level of that channel, from silence to the full input
Places that channel across the stereo field on a constant-power curve
Silences that channel over 3ms, and unmutes it over the same 3ms, so it does not click

inputs.text: The mono audio input of that channel
A stereo mix arriving from another Chain-family module, added to the left output at the level it arrives
A stereo mix arriving from another Chain-family module, added to the right output at the level it arrives

outputs.text: The left output: the four panned channels plus the left chain input
The right output: the four panned channels plus the right chain input

notes: the chain jacks carry a running stereo mix. Patch one module's outputs into the next module's chain inputs to add channels, and take the last module's outputs as the mix
